messages:
lia: Quick follow-up from today's allocator sync — I'm proposing an 'allocator transparency' surface so the runtime exposes per-tenant fragmentation metrics + a defrag-scheduling hint API. The idea: platform can request low-latency defrag windows vs background compaction and tune tenant budgets. Sketch below. Thoughts?

devin: Love the direction. Question: how expensive is kicking a defrag op? We need to quantify p99 tail impact. Can we do incremental compaction instead of monolithic passes? :thinking:

cho: incremental is doable. We already have slab-coalesce primitives — can we expose a 'work quota' token and checkpoint barrier? e.g., runtime accepts {tenant, work_units, deadline_ms}. It'll run compaction opportunistically up to work_units.

lia: exactly. Proposed API:
```json
{
 "tenant_id": "string",
 "work_units": 100, 
 "priority": "low|normal|urgent",
 "deadline_ms": 200
}
```
Runtime returns "applied_units" and "estimated_latency_ms". Could also include a 'preempt' flag.

sam: How does this interact with offload eviction? If we compact hot pages we might increase host staging churn and cause more GPU page faults.

devin: Good call. We should coordinate with eviction controller. Maybe runtime can return an 'offload_delta' estimate (bytes moved to host) so scheduler can decide to defer.

lia: Also thinking about safety and versioning: the surface should be opt-in per tenant via cfg flag; default off. We'll gate with telemetry experiments.

cho: Telemetry: host page churn, compaction throughput, reclaimed_bytes, extra_faults. Suggest names: compaction.reclaimed_bytes, compaction.work_units, compaction.offload_bytes.

sam: For compatibility, keep simple first: accept work_units and priority. The rest can be in telemetry. Also need quotas: tenants shouldn't be able to starve others by scheduling continuous urgent defrags.

lia: Agreed — add per-tenant rate limit and global concurrency cap. Action items:
- lia: prototype API + unit tests (this week)
- devin: benchmark incremental vs full pass on 32GB model (next sprint)
- cho: add telemetry counters and a PromQL dashboard (end of week)
- sam: draft RBAC + opt-in policy for Private deployments

infra-bot: CI: allocator-proto tests passing on linux-x86-64 (build #789) :white_check_mark:

devin: One more thought — for Dedicated we can expose a 'maintenance window' hint so defrag can be scheduled during low load. Add that to the API as optional timestamp range.

lia: Nice. I'll update the proto. If no objections I'll post an RFC write-up tomorrow.
